messages:
zoe@redwood: Quick heads-up — spotted a small but blocking issue in the console observability examples for tracehook v3 migration.
marco@redwood: ok what's the blocker?
kai@redwood: tagging in case it affects SDK samples too @sam@redwood
zoe@redwood: the Python tracehook snippet still shows the old import and args. It 404s in the playground and fails the docs smoke check. Example currently:
```python
from redwood.obsv import TraceHook

hook = TraceHook(api_key=... , trace_key='trace')
```
Should be `from redwood.observability import TraceHook` and `trace_key` renamed to `trace_id_key` per v3.
marco@redwood: also the dashboard YAML sample has an extra `-` under `panels:` so the yaml loader fails. Small fix but breaks the quickstart preview.
sam@redwood: I can patch the Node/TS snippets after the Python fix. Do we want to keep the old parameter as an alias for a release or just update docs and call it out?
kai@redwood: prefer short-term alias in the SDK (deprecation notice) + doc callout. Docs should show new param with a short note: `(old: trace_key)`. Keeps customers from breaking.
zoe@redwood: agreed. Plan: Marco fixes examples & yaml, I add migration note and copy, Sam updates TS/Node samples, Kai adds a one-line changelog entry. Single docs PR ok?
marco@redwood: opening PR with the three sample changes + yaml fix. Ping me if you want separate commits.
docs-bot: PR draft created — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6210 by marco@redwood :construction:
sam@redwood: I'll push the TS snippet changes to that PR as a follow-up commit and run the smoke scripts against the playground.
kai@redwood: smoke test checklist: 1) netlify preview build 2) snippet execute for python & node 3) dashboard YAML lint. I can add a docs CI job to run those quick checks for PRs.
zoe@redwood: can we aim to merge today? This blocks a customer demo tomorrow. If CI green i'll approve.
marco@redwood: pushed python + yaml fix.
docs-bot: CI started for PR 6210 — checks: build, snippets-smoke, netlify-preview
sam@redwood: pushed TS examples and a tiny README migration note. Running local snippet runner now.
kai@redwood: added docs-ci job for snippet execution (quick container + example run). Triggering on the PR now.
marco@redwood: CI green on build & snippet-run, netlify preview pending.
zoe@redwood: reviewed copy, left one small phrasing nit about "per-token" -> "per-input-token" in cost breakdown paragraph. Not blocking.
marco@redwood: fixed the nit, force-pushed.
docs-bot: PR 6210 merged by marco@redwood — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6210 :tada:
zoe@redwood: awesome thanks all. i'll update the customer-facing migration note and send a short release email.
sam@redwood: will backport TS snippets to the v2 branch tomorrow morning.
kai@redwood: filed tiny SDK follow-up issue to track alias removal and compat handling.
marco@redwood: closing loop here. if preview surfaces anything else, re-open the PR. :+1:
zoe@redwood: thanks — great cross-team sync. :rocket:
